heroIntro: Get your boots on the ground with council member {councilName} and popular influencer {influencerName} on a three stop tour to experience the nightlife and support local businesses while building a relationship with your council member.
councilQuote: This isn't just about nightlife; it's about connecting with the community where they are. We're breaking down the walls of City Hall.
influencerQuote: District {district} has some of the most vibrant, unsung spots in the city. I can't wait to show everyone what makes this neighborhood tick.

stops.title: {influencerName}'s East Side Opener
stops.body: {influencerName} opens the crawl in {location} with a stop that puts New Orleans East and the Lower 9 on the map�music, food, and a room full of neighborhood pride.

stops.title: {councilName}'s Ward Favorite
stops.body: Councilmember {councilName} chooses a second stop rooted in the community: a place where locals gather, support each other, and keep the culture alive after dark.

stops.title: The District E Vote
stops.body: You decide the finale. Cast your vote for the {location} business you want featured as the third stop when we crawl on April 2.
